benchmark: extruct.rdfa and extruct.microformat: how often do real product pages state product facts only in RDFa or h-product microformats, which ECDEV does not read?
sites: 14 public retailers; product URLs from the first uncompressed product sitemap each robots.txt leads to; every request allowed by robots.txt for the ECDEV agent; GET only; 1.5 s between requests; at most 5 product pages per site
instrument: extruct from the donor checkout at dc3bf7d2209ecf421222afc90d3d2dd8c6fd23cf, installed in an isolated benchmark environment; not ECDEV runtime code
evidence_state: BENCHMARK_MEASUREMENT of structured-data formats on sampled pages at one time; not evidence about any product or market
findings: 34 of 40 product pages on 8 sites state the product in a format ECDEV reads (JSON-LD on all of them; microdata additionally on glossier.com).
0 pages carry an RDFa product and 0 an h-product microformat; 0 pages would gain anything from reading them.

The pages ECDEV cannot read lack structured product data in every format: uniqlo.com product pages are rendered client-side (og:type website, no JSON-LD), and one zappos.com page carried none. The gap is rendering, not RDFa or microformats.
lego.com answered 403 to the ECDEV user agent; patagonia.com, thriftbooks.com, bookshop.org and warbyparker.com yielded no product URL from an uncompressed sitemap within four sitemap requests.
newegg.com URLs matched the path rule but were search listings (/p/pl?d=); they are excluded from every count.

decision.rdfa: DELIBERATE_SEMANTIC_DIVERGENCE: not read; no sampled product page needed it
decision.microformat: DELIBERATE_SEMANTIC_DIVERGENCE: not read; no sampled product page needed it
decision.revisit_when: a source ECDEV targets states product facts only in RDFa or h-product
decision.follow_up: client-rendered product data (uniqlo.com) belongs to the changedetection.fetcher-selection question

limits: 40 product pages on 8 sites with usable samples, mostly direct-to-consumer and large retailers; small shops and marketplaces using RDFa themes were not sampled; one capture time

robots_compliance.incident: allbirds.com and ikea.com robots.txt contain rules beginning with a wildcard; ECDEV's evaluator then refused those files wholesale while robotparser skipped the rules, so pages ECDEV would have refused were fetched
robots_compliance.audit: after the evaluator fix (rules beginning with a wildcard honoured), all 110 URLs fetched by this and the companion benchmark are allowed by ECDEV's evaluator; none matches a rule that disallows it

harness_sources.reason: extruct is extinct; the script imported it, which is a build edge. The measurement is frozen in this record; the exact source is kept here as text, not as an executable under tools/.
